item.title: Spouse Visa and Residence Card Part 2: Visa Time
item.description:
Spouse Visa and Residence Card Part 2: The Japanese Visa

In the last post (Spouse Visa and Residence Card Part 1: The COE), I discussed the steps I took to apply and receive the Certficate of Eligibility (COE). With the COE in hand, now comes part two: applying for the Visa.

This part was probably the easiest in terms of getting this completed. I was pretty blown away on how simple and straightforward this process was.

item.title: Spouse Visa and Residence Card Part 1: COE and Me
item.description:
Spouse Visa and Residence Card Part 1: The COE

So, you’ve made the decision to move to Japan with your spouse - congratulations! Now, here comes the bureaucracy.

My wife is a Japanese national so naturally we applied for my Spouse Visa. This is one of several categories of visas that the country of Japan can issue. The full name of this visa is the Spouse or Child of Japanese National.
